newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia may issue 1.5 bln marks in next Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russia may issue 1.5 bln marks in next Eurobond.

text.p: Russia's second Eurobond issue may amount to 1.5 billion marks, Deputy Prime Minister Oleg Davydov said on Friday.
"Russian Eurobonds worth 1.5 billion marks will be issued in March," he told Reuters.
Previously the Finance Ministry has said the second Eurobond issue would amount to one billion marks.
Asked to comment on Davydov's remarks, Deputy Finance Minister Mikhail Kasyanov told Reuters the exact volume of the issue would be set after a road-show starting in the first half of March.
The Finance Ministry will announce the exact dates for the road-show at the beginning of next week, he said.
However, Kasyanov did not rule out the possibility that the Eurobond volume could exceed one billion marks.

Russia issued its first $1 billion Eurobond in November and the second mark-demonimated paper will follow in March. The government has said it plans to raise a total of $3 billion in Eurobonds in different currencies in 1997.
